name: Hellknight Deserter

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You became a squire to a Hellknight at a young age. As you matured and your opinions developed, you came to find their ethos unacceptable, and went from bearing shields for the Hellknights to bearing weapons against them.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Hellknight Lore skill. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.
